comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on any plan sheets. The grouping regulatory overview explicitly warns against 'Clearances measured from pole instead of conductor: Dimension annotations read "10'-0" from pole" instead of "15'-0" from outside conductor"; conductor may be several feet offset from pole center on three-phase installations.' This project provides no dimensions at all.
applicableAreas: Overhead electric line and all site features in proximity

comment: Overhead electric line is present on the southern boundary with buildings and driveways nearby.
